_doc: The only volume knobs. Edit, push with the dashboard, no code change. Files in sfx-real/ and music-real/ are loudness-normalised at build time (audio_real.py), so these gains are comparable across files. Narration is -16 LUFS. music_under = level while the narrator speaks, music_open = level in pauses. Gains are linear (0.5 = -6 dB).
